sample_unit: interview participants (chief medical informatics officers and similar) from 13 academic medical centers

links.outcome: Whether equity is considered in AI governance processes at academic medical centers
links.effect: A minority of participants reported considering inequity, racism, or bias in governance; a lack of consistent equity consideration was found among academic medical centers developing governance for predictive technologies.
links.quote: We found a lack of consistent equity consideration among academic medical centers as they develop their governance processes for predictive technologies despite considerable national attention to the ways these technologies can cause or reproduce inequities.

unlisted_practices: Building equity literacy among health system leadership

screen.reason: Qualitative empirical study evaluating how academic medical centers govern AI and consider equity in practice through interviews with health system leadership.
